js: (async () => { const s = await window.api.settings.get(); await window.api.settings.set({ llmProvider: 'custom', customBaseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:18777/v1', llmModels: { ...s.llmModels, custom: 'mock-model' } }); window.__klikKartu = (judul) => { const art = [...document.querySelectorAll('article')].find((a) => a.textContent.includes(judul)); if (!art) return false; const btn = art.querySelector('button'); if (!btn) return false; btn.click(); return true; }; window.__klikTombol = (teks) => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === teks); if (!b) return false; b.click(); return true; }; window.__teksAda = (teks) => document.body.innerText.includes(teks); console.log('FOKUS2-SETUP ok'); })()

(async () => { const list = await window.api.projects.list(); const p = list.find((x) => x.title === 'FOKUS Status'); window.__p = p ? p.id : null; const b = p ? await window.api.projects.get(p.id) : null; console.log('FOKUS2-PULIH p=' + window.__p + ' adegan=' + (b ? b.clips.length : '?') + ' klikKartu=' + window.__klikKartu('FOKUS Status')); })()

(() => { const h1 = document.querySelector('h1') ? document.querySelector('h1').textContent : ''; console.log('FOKUS2-HALAMAN h1=' + h1 + ' status60=' + window.__teksAda('Tersimpan 60 dari 218 adegan') + ' klikLanjut=' + window.__klikTombol('Lanjutkan naskah')); })()

(async () => { const b = await window.api.projects.get(window.__p); console.log('FOKUS2-SELESAI adegan=' + b.clips.length + ' (mau 218) status60Hilang=' + !window.__teksAda('Tersimpan 60 dari 218 adegan') + ' pil218=' + window.__teksAda('218 adegan') + ' tombolLanjutkanHilang=' + !window.__teksAda('Lanjutkan naskah')); })()
